Product Description

Gildan’s Youth Heavy Cotton T-Shirt is a great wardrobe addition that can be worn year-round to school, games or the playground. It’s made of sturdy, midweight 100% U.S. cotton and features a classic fit. Add colorful, fun graphics using screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers or give it a retro feel with bleach or tie dye. Companion styles for men, women and toddlers make it family friendly!

    Listen, if you're buying this shirt, you probably already know what you're getting—it's the classic, reliable, do-anything, Gildan Heavy Cotton tee, just scaled down for kids! And honestly, it lives up to its reputation.

    I bought a stack of these for a youth group project (think messy paint, tie-dye, and a lot of running around), and they were absolutely perfect.

    The Good Stuff:

    • Durability is Top-Notch: It’s called "Heavy Cotton" for a reason. This shirt holds up to a ton of abuse. We've washed them multiple times now, and they aren't falling apart, the seams are holding, and the collar isn't getting all floppy.

    • Holds Color (and Vinyl) Great: The colors were bright and consistent right out of the package. For our tie-dye project, the white took the dye beautifully. If you're using heat transfer vinyl or screen printing, this fabric is thick enough that you don't have to worry about the design bleeding through or the shirt puckering.

    • The Fit is a Classic: It's a standard, roomy, boxy cut. It's not trendy and slim, but that's exactly what you want for a kid's uniform, camp shirt, or just a play tee. They have plenty of room to move around.

    • Good Value: You simply can't beat the price for the quality you get. It’s an easy, low-cost essential.

    A Note on Sizing & Feel:

    • Sizing is True-to-Size (BUT): I found the youth sizes generally accurate for the age range (e.g., a Youth Small is a true small). However, they are 100% cotton, so they WILL shrink a little in the wash, especially if you throw them in the dryer on high heat. If your kid is borderline between two sizes, or if you plan to dry on high heat, I would highly recommend sizing up one size just to be safe.

    • The Feel: It's "heavy cotton," not "buttery soft." It's not scratchy by any means, but it's not a premium, super-soft tee either. It's comfortable, but its main feature is being tough and thick, not super plush.

    Overall: If you need a great blank canvas for a team, camp, art project, or just a dependable, everyday play shirt for your kid, the Gildan G5 is the workhorse you need. Just be mindful of that initial wash.

The fabric is incredibly soft against my skin – like a gentle hug all day long. It's the kind of softness that lasts wash after wash, too, which is a huge plus.

    The thickness of the material is just right. It's substantial enough to feel high-quality and durable, yet it's not so heavy that it feels bulky or stifling. It's the perfect weight for year-round wear, keeping me comfortable whether it's a warm summer day or I'm layering up in the cooler months. I've worn them on their own, under sweaters, and even dressed them up a bit with a blazer, and they always look and feel fantastic.

    And let's talk about value for money – these shirts are an absolute steal! The quality you get for the price is truly exceptional. I was expecting to pay a lot more for shirts that feel this luxurious and are made this well. They've held up beautifully through multiple washes, with no shrinking, fading, or pilling. That kind of durability is hard to find, especially at this price point.

    The material itself feels premium. It's clearly well-made and you can tell the craftsmanship is top-notch. The stitching is impeccable, and the overall construction is just superb. I can tell these shirts are going to last me a long time, making them an investment in my wardrobe that I'm incredibly happy with. If you're looking for comfortable, high-quality shirts that won't break the bank, look no further. These are a winner!

About this Item

  • Classic fit for loose comfort
  • Versatile mid-weight fabric for year-round wear
  • Taped neck and shoulders for comfort and durability
  • Non-topstitched, classic width, rib collar

Product Description

Gildan’s Youth Heavy Cotton T-Shirt is a great wardrobe addition that can be worn year-round to school, games or the playground. It’s made of sturdy, midweight 100% U.S. cotton and features a classic fit. Add colorful, fun graphics using screen printing, embroidery, iron-on transfers or give it a retro feel with bleach or tie dye. Companion styles for men, women and toddlers make it family friendly!
